text.crisis.raiders.title: Cargo-rail raiders
text.crisis.raiders.description: Hooked skiffs close on the cargo rail; their goal is theft and escape.
text.crisis.creature.title: Rudder grazer
text.crisis.creature.description: A broad-backed river grazer holds the rudder shoal. Height, bait or spaced strikes can free the vessel.
text.crisis.lure.title: The answering hull
text.crisis.lure.description: Mineral resonance makes familiar voices seem to call from the wrong bank. Chart, chain and named witnesses remain reliable.
text.crisis.boarders.title: The two-rail boarding
text.crisis.boarders.description: A bowman holds the upper rail while a hook bearer approaches the stair. Break the lane, divide them across decks or buy passage.
text.crisis.hold-thieves.title: The loosened hatch
text.crisis.hold-thieves.description: A hold thief seeks a counted shipment below while a net bearer covers the hatch. Recover the physical lot before it escapes.
text.crisis.storm.title: A parting stay
text.crisis.storm.description: Wind works a cracked upper stay. The rigging at 55,10,+1 needs bracing; leaving it risks the hull and loose cargo.
text.crisis.shoal.title: The silt shoulder
text.crisis.shoal.description: Newly deposited silt narrows the sounding. A slower pilot passage saves the hold; forcing it risks the hull.
text.crisis.driftwood.title: A raft without its rope
text.crisis.driftwood.description: Useful timber drifts past a broken carrier raft. A rope can secure one lot, but exposure delays the route.
text.crisis.galley-fire.title: The spilled lamp
text.crisis.galley-fire.description: Lamp oil catches beside the galley. Water and the galley fire cover can smother it; smoke can reach the hatch.
text.crisis.split-seam.title: A working hull seam
text.crisis.split-seam.description: A lower seam admits water. The lower repair stores at 20,15,-1 can seat a brace before the hold takes more water.
text.crisis.flooded-hold.title: The loaded bilge
text.crisis.flooded-hold.description: Water has followed the cargo hatch below. Work the bilge at 8,15,-1 or accept damage and abandoned cargo.
text.crisis.inspection.title: A disputed cargo seal
text.crisis.inspection.description: A river work patrol asks whose claim supports the cargo. Witnesses, paper or a declared payment can settle the inspection.
text.crisis.choice.deck.return: Return to the deck while danger advances
text.crisis.choice.deck.withdraw: Abandon contested cargo and withdraw with hull damage
text.crisis.choice.lure.navigate: Navigate by chart and lead line
text.crisis.choice.shoal.navigate: Sound a slower channel: four extra actions
text.crisis.choice.shoal.navigate.variant: Sound a slower channel: six extra actions
text.crisis.choice.shoal.yield: Force the shoal: two hull integrity
text.crisis.choice.shoal.yield.variant: Force the shoal: three hull integrity
text.crisis.choice.driftwood.repel: Secure timber: one rope use, three actions
text.crisis.choice.driftwood.repel.variant: Secure timber: one rope use, four actions; gain timber and charcoal
text.crisis.choice.driftwood.yield: Let the raft pass without a claim
text.crisis.choice.inspection.navigate: Offer witnessed institutional trust or one paper lot
text.crisis.choice.inspection.yield: Refuse: lose one cargo lot to detention
text.crisis.choice.boarders.counsel: Settle one named institutional obligation before boarding
text.crisis.choice.default.withdraw: Withdraw: abandon cargo and accept two hull damage
text.crisis.choice.tactical.deck: Take the deck and face the boarding danger
text.crisis.line.work_position: Work position: {x},{y},z{z}. E previews the intervention.
text.crisis.line.boarders: Defeat, negotiate or drive off the boarders. V offers nearby terms; R accepts withdrawal losses.
text.crisis.line.pump: A fitted bilge pump can clear water without repairing a seam. Inspect nearby wiring with \.
text.crisis.line.help: F inspects materials; A targets visible threats; O reads intent. Hatches take one action under danger.
text.crisis.line.pending: Inspection and Escape cost no time. The event remains pending until resolved.
text.intent.crisis.netting: cuts through fitted cargo-rail netting before reaching the loose shipment
text.intent.crisis.baited: follows the material bait out of the rudder shoal
text.intent.crisis.retreated: abandons the claim and returns to its boarding point
text.intent.crisis.surrendered: surrenders after failing to find a withdrawal route
text.crisis.begin.invalid: Only an active physical voyage can open the working decks.
text.crisis.begin.continues: The deck crisis continues; no extra time passes while inspecting.
text.crisis.begin.alarm.station: Deck alarm: {title}. Every move now takes time; the boarders are still preparing. Work the marked station at {station}.
text.crisis.begin.alarm.boarders: Deck alarm: {title}. Every move now takes time; the boarders are still preparing. Watch the boarders or leave with R.
text.crisis.finish.hazard_settled: The physical hazard is no longer active; material intervention or endurance clears the passage. Earlier damage remains.
text.crisis.finish.abandon: The courier orders withdrawal; {loss}; hull loses two integrity. Existing fire and water remain for repair.
text.crisis.advance.work_undone: {title}: the work at {x},{y},z{z} remains undone; hull {integrity}/10.
text.crisis.advance.assist: {person} assists from the adjacent deck position against {target}.
text.crisis.advance.leave: {threat} leaves by its boarding point; the failed claim is recorded.
text.crisis.finish.decks_clear: The contested decks are clear. Unclaimed physical possessions remain where they fell.
text.crisis.station.bait: Offer counted fish from a physical hold position.
text.crisis.station.gangplank: The gangplank cannot leave an unresolved voyage.
text.crisis.station.meal: Prepare a meal from counted provisions.
text.crisis.station.treat: Inspect injury treatment at this berth.
text.crisis.work.detail.repair: Two action-clock steps and one timber lot restore three hull integrity. No timber means no work or time charged.
text.crisis.work.detail.pump: Three action-clock steps pump sparse water from this deck, without erasing fire or changing cargo ownership.
text.crisis.work.detail.meal: One grain or salt-fish lot and four action-clock steps restore two health and clear fatigue; persistent injury remains.
text.crisis.work.detail.emergency: Three exposed action-clock steps secure this physical control. A rope/lever preparation helps a cracked stay; the galley cover smothers oil, the repair brace seats the seam, and the bilge pumps water.
text.crisis.work.detail.bait: One salt-fish lot and one exposed action draw the rudder grazer clear. Fish is consumed; no animal is summoned or slain.
text.crisis.work.detail.treat: With a fitted sickbay sling cot, one wool lot and six action-clock steps clear one persistent injury. Lost health and other injuries remain.
text.crisis.work.line.confirm: Confirm F; Escape cancels. Damage already suffered and lost items are not undone.
text.crisis.work.none: This is not the selected physical work position.
text.crisis.work.invalid_station: Work requires the physical vessel station.
text.crisis.work.bait_requirement: This shoal needs {required} counted salt-fish lot{suffix} for bait.
text.crisis.work.bait: {required} salt-fish lot{suffix} draw the territorial {animal} clear of the rudder.
text.crisis.work.repair_requirement: Repair needs a timber lot and actual hull damage.
text.crisis.work.repair: One timber lot seats a physical hull repair: three integrity restored.
text.crisis.work.pump_requirement: The bilge is already dry; no pumping work is needed.
text.crisis.work.pump: The bilge shift pumps this deck's counted water. Active unseated seams may admit more.
text.crisis.work.pump.strainers: Twin strainers make the physical stroke one action.
text.crisis.work.meal_requirement: The galley needs one counted grain or salt-fish lot.
text.crisis.work.meal: A shared {food} meal restores {restored} health and eases fatigue; injuries still need treatment.
text.crisis.work.treat.cot: This berth has no fitted sickbay sling cot.
text.crisis.work.treat.injury: The courier has no persistent injury for the sling cot.
text.crisis.work.treat.wool: Sling-cot treatment needs one clean wool hold lot.
text.crisis.work.treat: The sling cot and one wool lot clear {injury} at {location}; lost health and other injuries remain.
text.crisis.work.emergency.requirement: The stay needs a readied rope or lever craft; another courier can prepare it before the next voyage.
text.crisis.work.emergency: Physical emergency work secures the marked position; existing damage elsewhere remains.
text.crisis.work.emergency.pressure: The active voyage variant adds one exposed action for its second material front.
text.crisis.work.emergency.accelerated: The fitted station removes one exposed action.
text.crisis.defeat.message: {text} {outcome} during a declared deck crisis; the physical load remains at {x},{y},z{z}. Regional quests were not reset.
